allies.rationale_text: Critical-thinking gives curiosity a disciplined way to evaluate evidence, notice bias, and compare perspectives rather than just asking more questions.
allies.source_quote: Curiosity provides the drive for critical thinking.
allies.affinity_rationale: Described as 'provides the drive for critical thinking' — curiosity motivates the evaluative process of examining evidence, noticing biases, and considering multiple perspectives.
allies.activation_condition: When critical evaluation requires the motivational drive to actively seek out evidence and multiple perspectives rather than settling for the first satisfactory answer

allies.rationale_text: First-principles-thinking channels curiosity into fundamental questions that strip away assumptions and expose the elemental truths underneath the current frame.
allies.source_quote: Curiosity drives the continuous process of asking fundamental questions that strip away assumptions to arrive at the elemental truths.
allies.affinity_rationale: Described as 'drives the continuous process of asking fundamental questions that strip away assumptions to arrive at elemental truths' — curiosity fuels the relentless questioning that first-principles reasoning demands.
allies.activation_condition: When assumption-stripping requires the persistent questioning drive that prevents premature closure on conventional explanations

antagonists.rationale_text: Einstellung-effect undermines curiosity by locking the thinker onto a familiar framework so that the drive to investigate further is short-circuited before new inquiry paths can open.
antagonists.source_quote: Curiosity is inhibited when an expert relies on frameworks that worked previously ('I have seen this one before') when faced with a genuinely novel problem.
antagonists.affinity_rationale: Mapped from canonical Maslow's Hammer — fixation on familiar tools causes practitioners to 'torture reality so that it fits your models', which curiosity overcomes by pushing for a multidisciplinary approach.
antagonists.activation_condition: When familiarity with existing solution patterns creates fixation that blocks the exploratory questioning curiosity demands
